item.title: Apple Unveils Variable‑Aperture Camera on iPhone 18 Pro
item.description: Apple’s September 2026 event unveiled a variable‑aperture camera on both iPhone 18 Pro models, featuring a 48‑MP fusion sensor and laser‑cut blades for cinematic control.
